How to get here

  1. Take the city tram to Tenmonkan-dori stop.
  2. Walk around to the back of the Centerrace Tenmonkan building.
  3. The Kurakawa Building is next to Mangetsu Okonomiyaki.
  4. Izumi Seinikuten is on basement level 1.

If you are on a cruise or a short stay

We open at 16:00. Courses last 120 minutes, so please plan around your boarding time. 2 minutes on foot from the Tenmonkan-dori tram stop.

Questions & answers

Where are you? Is there parking?

Basement level 1 of the Kurakawa Building, 3-5 Sennichicho, Kagoshima City: 2 minutes on foot from the Tenmonkan-dori tram stop, behind Centerrace Tenmonkan. There is no parking; please use a nearby pay lot.

How late are you open?

We open at 16:00. Sunday to Thursday and holidays until 24:00 (last order 23:00); Friday, Saturday and days before holidays until 2:00 (last order 1:00). Closing days are irregular.

Reserve by phone. Same-day tables can be checked, too.

Phone lines open at 16:00. Courses are for two or more guests; table-only reservations are accepted from one guest.
